blocks.text: PROSPERIDAD, Agusan del Sur — While thousands of farmers across the province watched their fields parched from the prolonged dry spell, Roger Villegas stood beside stacks of freshly harvested palay on Wednesday, looking at an estimated P1.26 million payoff. Based on official crop sampling conducted by Department of Agriculture (DA) Caraga technicians during a local harvest festival, Villegas’s six-hectare hybrid rice model farm in Barangay San Vicente registered a yield exceeding 10 metric tons per hectare.
